title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Strawberry Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing Strawberry Ice by Vice, a delectable E-liquid that captures the essence of ripe, juicy strawberries with a chilling twist of icy freshness. Prepare to be immersed in a world of fruity delight and invigorating coolness.
With every inhale, you’ll experience the succulent notes of freshly picked strawberries, bursting with sweetness and tang. The authentic flavor profile will transport you to sun-kissed fields, indulging your senses in the juicy goodness of this beloved fruit.
As you exhale, the coolness of the icy sensation emerges, enveloping your palate with a refreshing blast. The combination of the vibrant strawberry flavor and the invigorating menthol creates a perfectly balanced vaping experience that keeps you coming back for more.
Vice takes pride in delivering a smooth and satisfying throat hit, ensuring your vaping experience is as enjoyable as it is flavorful. The expertly crafted blend of high-quality ingredients guarantees consistency and premium quality in every puff.
Strawberry Ice by Vice is a must-have for fruit lovers and menthol enthusiasts alike. Its irresistible combination of juicy strawberries and icy coolness will awaken your taste buds and provide a refreshing escape from the ordinary. Treat yourself to the delightful symphony of flavors and experience vaping bliss with Strawberry Ice by Vice.
Flavour Notes:
Strawberry
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
